title: Phnom Penh food & drinks
sub: Best eats and drinks near Baitong Hotel (BKK1), Nov 2026
tip: Short on time? Lunch at Eleven One Kitchen, dinner at Malis, then drinks on Bassac Lane. Sundowner on the hotel's own Lantern Rooftop Bar. Khmer Surin and Bassac Pho pins are approximate (exact spot not found), both are a couple of minutes from the hotel.

places.name: Eleven One Kitchen
notes: Cheap, healthy home-style Khmer, best lunch
Get the fish amok and crispy seafood taro nest

places.name: Malis
notes: The famous upmarket Khmer restaurant, do one nice dinner here
Pretty garden courtyard, book ahead for dinner

places.name: Khmer Surin
notes: Khmer and Thai since 1996, old wooden house with a garden
Pin approximate: on St 57 just by the hotel, open about 7am-10pm

places.name: Sovanna BBQ
notes: Lively local table-top Khmer BBQ, beer and grilled meat
Opens about 11am, best in the evening

places.name: Bassac Pho BKK
notes: Vietnamese pho and bun bo Hue, rated highly but few reviews
Pin approximate: basically next door to the hotel

places.name: Bassac Lane
notes: Tiny alley of small cocktail bars, the best night out nearby
